newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag says E2 licence delayed to May 15.
newsitem.headline: Viag says E2 licence delayed to May 15.

text.p: German diversified utilities group Viag AG said on Monday that it did not expect the E-2 mobile telephone licence to be handed over until May 15, saying some outstanding points still had to be cleared up.
But it denied a report in German news magazine Der Spiegel which said differences in opinion over the company's telecommunications strategy were behind the delay.
Viag plans to launch its E2 network in the summer of 1998. The network will be operated by Viag Intercom, a joint venture between Viag and British telecommunications group British Telecom.
Viag also denied Speigel's speculation that Viag Intercom was considering working together with another telephone group, E-plus.
A spokesman said that a cooperation with E-plus was not possible for regulatory, technical and economic reasons.
